propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge on GitHub because it is a read-only mirror; the updates must be re-landed as three independent Gerrit changes and the PRs closed by hand.
pip-audit CI gate blocks all Verified runs due to PYSEC-2026-2132 (click 8.2.1 command injection); a P0 Gerrit change must bump click to >=8.3.3 in uv.lock and merge first to unblock.

PR #123 updates github-actions to setup-python v7 across 13 workflow files and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish; the change must be applied verbatim via git apply and validated by its Verified CI run exercising the new setup-python@v7.

PR #124 bumps mcp 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major) and ruff 0.15.22 to 0.16.1; mcp 2.0 breaks rebar-mcp imports (mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP, mcp.server.auth.*, mcp.server.transport_security, mcp.types.ToolAnnotations) — if compat shims hold, apply full diff; if breakage is structural, land ruff-only and defer mcp v2 migration to a follow-up ticket.

Two out-of-pyproject.toml mcp version constraints must be kept coherent with the landing decision: .github/workflows/_optionality.yml:105 (mcp>=1.28.1,<2 or <3) and docs/adr/0050-mcp-optional-auth-resource-server.md (rationale note) require amendment if mcp 2.0 is landed, or remain unchanged if mcp stays <2.
After all Gerrit changes merge, both PRs #123 and #124 must be closed on GitHub with comments naming the corresponding Gerrit changes, so dependabot stops re-opening them on the next mirror sync.
